hook: Graduate voter list: *4.96 lakh* applications still pending
tldr: Of 5.24 lakh graduate-voter applications in two Telangana seats, 1,581 were rejected. Deadline to apply: Nov 6.

beats.what: Telangana's election office has approved 26,085 and rejected 1,581 graduate-voter applications so far.
beats.why: Rejections were for degrees finished after Oct 31, 2023, and for suspected fake certificates.
beats.care: Graduated by Oct 31, 2023? Apply by Nov 6 on ceotelangana.nic.in (Form-18). Result date counts, not certificate date.

cards.body: Two seats are open for enrolment: Mahabubnagar–Rangareddy–Hyderabad and Warangal–Khammam–Nalgonda. Applications came in big, but most are still being checked.

cards.caption: of the 1,581 rejections are in Warangal–Khammam–Nalgonda

cards.q: Are you enrolled as a graduate voter?

cards.why: You need 3 years as a graduate before the Nov 1, 2026 qualifying date.

learn.t: Graduates' constituencies elect members of the Legislative Council (MLCs). Only people who graduated at least 3 years before the qualifying date can vote.

watch: Verification of the 4.96 lakh pending forms, and the draft roll once the Nov 6 window closes.
